document_title: University of California Annual Financial Report 2023-24, 'Campus Facts in Brief (Unaudited)' - Campus Financial Facts
quote: Campus Financial Facts (in thousands of dollars), column 'Berkeley': University endowments - 'Nonspendable endowments 430,078'; 'Other endowments 4,440,052'. Campus foundations' endowments - 'Nonspendable endowments and gifts 1,879,882'; 'Other endowments 1,296,224'.
caveats: Arithmetic (thousands converted to whole dollars; the sums are ours, the table prints only the component lines): Regents-held 430,078 + 4,440,052 = 4,870,130; foundation 1,879,882 + 1,296,224 = 3,176,106; total 8,046,236. These pages sit inside the UC annual financial report but are labelled '(Unaudited)'; the audited statements (PwC, November 18, 2024) do not show endowment by campus. The Regents-held endowment is legally an asset of The Regents (the system), designated for the campus. A second official document uses a different basis (investment market values, unaudited, prepared by Mercer for UC Investments): UC Annual Endowment Report, fiscal year ended June 30, 2024, section 3.2 'Total University Endowed Assets', PDF p. 7 (https://www.ucop.edu/investment-office/investment-reports/annual-reports/annual-endwoment-report-fy-2023-2024.pdf), row 'Berkeley' in $ thousands: Regents 5,768,629; Foundation investments in GEP 0, in BGP 0, in STIP 16,169; Foundation 3,096,139; Total Endowment Assets 8,880,937. On that basis the foundation columns sum to 3,112,308 (our addition). Its 'Regents' column is 'assets managed by Regents in GEP and BGP for the benefit of the campuses' and so is wider than the annual report's 'University endowments'; neither figure from that report matches IPEDS. Foundation audited statements not opened (ucberkeleyfoundation.org returned HTTP 403). The audited Note 21 of the UC annual report (PDF p. 106) shows the Berkeley foundation's total net position of 3,547,020 thousand, which is a broader measure than endowment.
